label: resolutionSaved: newImage never keeps the setup's resolution, so a 300 ppi image reads 72
transparentBackground: a transparent background fills white, so the new image has no alpha
replace: case .transparent: return RGBA(r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1)

label: limitsIgnored: a setup past the limits is not refused before the open image is replaced
find: if let problem = setup.problems(Self.documentLimits).first { throw PhotoRefusal(problem.text) }
